title: Trace one key through immutable runs
description: Choose a lookup shape, then change run count, Bloom-filter memory, and block-cache coverage. The model shows which work is avoided and which disk reads remain.

workloads.label: Miss-heavy point reads
workloads.detail: Most requested keys do not exist, so Bloom filters can prevent candidate block reads.

workloads.label: Hit-heavy point reads
workloads.detail: Most keys exist. Filters still reject older runs, while the cache decides whether the winning data block reaches disk.

workloads.label: Narrow range scan
workloads.detail: The range overlaps part of each run. Bloom filters cannot reject a range, so run overlap and cache coverage dominate.
